questionEnglish: Which virus is responsible for causing the COVID-19 pandemic?
questionOdia: କୋଭିଡ୍-୧୯ (COVID-19) ମହାମାରୀ ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ଭୂତାଣୁ (Virus) ଦାୟୀ?
explanation: COVID-19 is caused by a coronavirus strain named Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2).

questionEnglish: In which city was the first case of COVID-19 identified in late 2019?
questionOdia: ୨୦୧୯ ଶେଷ ଆଡ଼କୁ କେଉଁ ସହରରେ କୋଭିଡ୍-୧୯ ର ପ୍ରଥମ ମାମଲା ଚିହ୍ନଟ ହୋଇଥିଲା?
explanation: The initial outbreak of COVID-19 was reported in Wuhan, Hubei Province, China, in December 2019.

questionEnglish: What is the primary diagnostic test used to detect active SARS-CoV-2 infection by amplifying viral RNA?
questionOdia: ଭୂତାଣୁର RNA କୁ ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରି ସକ୍ରିୟ କୋଭିଡ୍ ସଂକ୍ରମଣ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିବା ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ପରୀକ୍ଷା (Diagnostic Test) ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଏ?
explanation: Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-PCR) is considered the gold standard molecular test for identifying active COVID-19 cases.

questionEnglish: Which organ in the human body is most severely affected by the SARS-CoV-2 virus?
questionOdia: SARS-CoV-2 ଭୂତାଣୁ ଦ୍ୱାରା ମାନବ ଶରୀରର କେଉଁ ଅଙ୍ଗ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଭାବେ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
explanation: SARS-CoV-2 primarily targets the respiratory system, attaching to ACE2 receptors in the lungs, which can lead to severe pneumonia and ARDS.

questionEnglish: What type of vaccine is the Pfizer-BioNTech and Moderna COVID-19 vaccine?
questionOdia: ଫାଇଜର (Pfizer) ଏବଂ ମଡର୍ଣ୍ଣା (Moderna) ର କୋଭିଡ୍ ଟିକା କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ଟିକା ଅଟେ?
explanation: These vaccines use messenger RNA (mRNA) technology to instruct cells to produce a harmless piece of the viral spike protein, triggering an immune response.

questionEnglish: Which Indian regulatory body approved the emergency use authorization of COVID-19 vaccines like Covishield and Covaxin?
questionOdia: କୋଭିସିଲ୍ଡ ଓ କୋଭାକ୍ସିନ୍ ଭଳି କୋଭିଡ୍ ଟିକାର ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ ବ୍ୟବହାର ପାଇଁ ଭାରତର କେଉଁ ନିୟାମକ ସଂସ୍ଥା ଅନୁମତି ଦେଇଥିଲା?
explanation: The Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI) heading the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) gives final drug and vaccine approvals in India.

questionEnglish: The term 'Delta' and 'Omicron' refer to what in the context of COVID-19?
questionOdia: କୋଭିଡ୍-୧୯ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ 'ଡେଲ୍‌ଟା' (Delta) ଏବଂ 'ଓମିକ୍ରନ୍' (Omicron) ଶବ୍ଦ କାହାକୁ ସୂଚାଏ?
explanation: Delta and Omicron are names given by the World Health Organization (WHO) to major mutated Variants of Concern (VoC) of the SARS-CoV-2 virus.

questionEnglish: What does the '19' in COVID-19 stand for?
options: The year 2019 when it was discovered
answer: The year 2019 when it was discovered
explanation: COVID-19 stands for Corona Virus Disease 2019, reflecting the year the outbreak was first identified.

questionEnglish: Which device was widely used during the pandemic to measure oxygen saturation levels in a patient's blood non-invasively?
questionOdia: ମହାମାରୀ ସମୟରେ ରୋଗୀର ରକ୍ତରେ ଅମ୍ଳଜାନର ମାତ୍ରା ମାପିବା ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ଯନ୍ତ୍ର ବହୁଳ ଭାବେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୋଇଥିଲା?
explanation: A pulse oximeter is a small device clipped onto a finger that uses light absorption to monitor blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) levels.

questionEnglish: What condition describes the long-term symptoms that persist for weeks or months after recovering from the acute COVID-19 infection?
questionOdia: କୋଭିଡ୍ ସଂକ୍ରମଣରୁ ସୁସ୍ଥ ହେବାର ସପ୍ତାହ ବା ମାସ ପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ରହିଯାଉଥିବା ଦୀର୍ଘକାଳୀନ ଲକ୍ଷଣକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Long COVID (also known as post-COVID syndrome) refers to a range of ongoing, returning, or new health problems people experience after their initial recovery.
